text: The SEC's efforts to clarify and optimize the post Dodd-Frank framework cut both ways: they supported industry compliance with the revised standards while simultaneously creating uncertainty and higher costs for the industry.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097

isBasedOn.name: Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016

abstract: At the same time, there is sufficient evidence in the findings of this study suggesting that the SEC's implementation and clarification of Dodd-Frank Act registration and reporting requirements for private funds also created uncertainty and higher costs for the industry.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: SEC implementation and clarification of Title IV registration and reporting rules
